name: Autopilot
description: Reads player state every physics step and plays the level by itself. Auto safe mode: bot runs never save. Optional Gemini tuning.

use-ai.name: Use Gemini tuning
use-ai.description: After some deaths, send a compact summary to Gemini and apply the parameters it suggests.

api-key.name: Gemini API Key
api-key.description: Get one free at aistudio.google.com/apikey. Never share your mod settings file with the key in it.

model.name: Gemini Model
model.description: Change this if the default model gets retired.

jump-lead.name: Jump lead (seconds)
jump-lead.description: How many seconds before an obstacle the bot reacts.

ship-margin.name: Ship/Wave margin
ship-margin.description: Safety distance kept from obstacles when steering.
